# Psalm 138 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Of-David. I-will-give-thanks-to-you with-all my-heart; before gods I-will-sing-praises-to-you.

**2** I-will-bow-down toward-temple-of your-holiness, and-I-will-give-thanks-to your-name for your-steadfast-love and-for-your-faithfulness; for you-have-magnified above all your-name your-saying.

**3** In-day I-called and-you-answered-me; you-strengthened-me in-my-soul with-strength.

**4** Will-give-thanks-to-you O-YHWH all kings-of the-earth, for they-have-heard the-sayings-of your-mouth.

**5** And-they-will-sing in-ways-of YHWH, for great the-glory-of YHWH.

**6** For high YHWH and-the-lowly he-sees, and-the-haughty from-afar he-knows.

**7** If I-walk in-midst-of distress you-will-revive-me; against anger-of my-enemies you-will-stretch-out your-hand, and-will-save-me your-right-hand.

**8** YHWH will-complete for-me; O-YHWH your-steadfast-love to-forever; works-of your-hands do-not forsake.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **138:2**: 'You-have-magnified above all your-name your-saying' — God's word is elevated even above his reputation; what he has spoken surpasses everything.

- **138:6**: 'The-lowly he-sees, and-the-haughty from-afar he-knows' — God's attention goes to the humble; the proud he perceives but keeps at distance.

— EMET
